Measurement-year window is only a container; gestational timing is captured separately.\"}, {\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"gestational age at time of test (must fall at 24 to 28 weeks' gestation); windows cannot be expressed relative to gestation\"}, \"quote\": \"at 24 to 28 weeks' gestation\"}]}","exclusions":"[{\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"Rh(D) status of the biological father\"}, \"quote\": \"unless the biological father is known to be Rh(D)-negative\"}]"}],"coverage_notes":["New concepts introduced (not in vocabulary): rh_d_negative_unsensitized (Rh(D)-negative blood type without anti-D sensitization) and rh_d_antibody_test (Rh(D) antibody screen).
